title: Impersonal 7: Mixed Review (the family diagnostic)
description: All seven families of impersonal constructions from this track brought together: permission, necessity, advice, timing, state, reflexive, and absence. A step-by-step diagnostic walks you through choosing and producing the right family for any context. Nothing new is taught.
descriptionRussian: Все семь семей безличных конструкций трека собраны вместе: разрешение, необходимость, совет, время, состояние, возвратные безличные и отсутствие. Пошаговая диагностика помогает выбрать и построить нужную семью для любого контекста. Ничего нового не вводится.
intro: Seven families, one shape. No subject anywhere, the person in the dative, and tense carried by a frozen neuter word that never agrees with anybody. Run down the list in order and stop at the first one that fits: allowed, required, advised, timely, felt, or one of the reflexive frames.
rules: Run the diagnostic in order until the first 'yes': allowed/forbidden, required, advised, the moment has come, a feeling/state, a 'by-itself' wanting or success, or simply absent. The first match picks the family.

The seven families: permission (можно/нельзя), necessity (нужно/надо), advice (следует/стоит/лучше), timing (пора), state (холодно, грустно, трудно), reflexive (хочется, кажется, удаётся), absence (нет + genitive).
There is no nominative subject. The person who feels or needs sits in the dative (Маше нужно), and for absence in 'у меня' or in the genitive of the absent person (Маши нет дома).
Tense rides on a frozen neuter form: было for the past, будет for the future, never agreeing with the dative person (Маше было холодно, not была).
The reflexive family uses its own neuter past (хотелось, удалось), and absence uses не было / не будет.
examples: Здесь нельзя курить. (Smoking is not allowed here.) Permission family: prohibition.
Мне нужно идти. (I need to go.) Necessity family.
Тебе следует отдохнуть. (You ought to rest.) Advice family.
Маше пора домой. (It is time for Masha to head home.) Timing family, dropped motion verb.
Маше было грустно вчера. (Masha was sad yesterday.) State family, past tense.
Мне хочется кофе. (I feel like some coffee.) Reflexive family.
У меня нет ручки. (I have no pen.) Absence family, genitive of the missing thing.

tables.title: The seven families at a glance

items.promptEnglish: I feel like some coffee, I am very tired.
items.hint: A soft wanting-feeling that happens 'by itself'. Which family?
items.explanation: Хочется names the soft wanting-feeling in the reflexive family. Хочу would require я in the nominative ('I want'), a personal subject, not an impersonal frame. Нужно names necessity, not a feeling. Пора names timing, not desire.

items.promptEnglish: You may not talk loudly in the library.
items.hint: A rule of conduct in a public place. Which family?
items.explanation: The library context names a rule, the classic permission setting, and нельзя is the prohibition predicative. Трудно (state) would mean 'it is hard to', хочется (reflexive) a feeling, and стоит (advice) 'it is worth', none of which carry the prohibition.

items.promptEnglish: I have no time, let's do it tomorrow.
items.hint: Absence family: нет always takes the genitive. Время is a tricky neuter noun.
items.explanation: Нет governs the genitive, and the genitive of время is времени. Время is the nominative, used only when it exists (у меня есть время).

items.prompt: Тебе _____ поговорить с врачом, твой кашель не проходит.
items.promptEnglish: You ought to talk to a doctor; your cough is not going away.
items.hint: Formal advice from one person to another. Which family?
items.explanation: Следует carries the formal 'ought to' reading of the advice family, fitting the medical context. Пора is timing (the moment has come), нельзя is prohibition, and хочется is the reflexive wanting-feeling. The recommendation reading is advice.

items.promptEnglish: Anton will be bored on his own at home.
items.hint: Future state predicative; what gender and number does the tense word take?
items.explanation: State family, future tense. The tense word stays neuter будет in the future, never agreeing with the dative person. Был (masc) and была (fem) would need a personal nominative subject, and было is past, the wrong tense for 'will be'.

items.promptEnglish: Masha did not manage to finish her work on time.
items.hint: Reflexive family: the past of удаться is fixed neuter singular.
items.explanation: The reflexive past is always neuter singular: удалось. Удался and удалась would agree with a nominative subject ('эксперимент удался'), a different sentence. Удавалось is the imperfective past for a habitual or ongoing process, but the prompt names a single bounded event, which is perfective.

items.promptEnglish: It is late, it is time for Anton to head home.
items.hint: The moment has arrived, and the motion verb is dropped before домой.
items.explanation: Пора is the timing family, and only пора can drop the motion verb when a destination is named: Антону пора домой. Нужно (necessity) would still need an infinitive (нужно идти), удаётся (reflexive) reports a success, and грустно (state) a feeling. The cue 'уже поздно' confirms timing.

items.prompt: Маше _____ сегодня, хотя всё в порядке.
items.promptEnglish: Masha feels sad today although everything is fine.
items.hint: Turn the long adjective into an impersonal state.
items.explanation: The impersonal state uses the short predicative with a dative person: Маше грустно. Грустная is a long adjective needing a nominative subject (Маша грустная is a claim about her character).

items.hint: Past tense of the state frame.
items.explanation: The past of a state predicative is the frozen neuter было: Маше было холодно. Была would wrongly agree with Маша; the dative person is not a subject.

blanks: Закрой окно, _____ холодно. (Close the window, the child is cold.)
Уже поздно, нам _____ домой. (It is late, it is time for us to head home.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Three families in one set. The state predicative холодно takes a dative person (ребёнку, from ребёнок). The absence frame uses present-tense нет with the absent person in the genitive (Маши). The timing family пора drops the motion verb before домой. Хочется is the reflexive wanting-feeling and fits none of these slots.

sentenceBuilding.hint: Permission family: нельзя + infinitive for a prohibition.
Necessity family: dative person + нужно + infinitive.

sentenceBuilding.translation: It is time for Anton to head to work.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Timing family: destination на работу (accusative); the motion verb drops.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Close the window; the child is cold.
errorCorrection.explanation: The state family takes a dative person, not a nominative: ребёнку, the dative of ребёнок. The nominative ребёнок would need a long adjective ('ребёнок холодный' = a cold person). The feeling is wired through the dative.

errorCorrection.sentence: Нам редко удаёт решать такие задачи быстро.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: We rarely manage to solve such problems quickly.
errorCorrection.explanation: The impersonal reflexive удаваться keeps -ся in every form: нам удаётся. 'Удаёт' without the -ся is not a Russian word.

minimalPairs.explanation: The reflexive family requires a dative person (мне), not a nominative subject. 'Я хочется' is ungrammatical because the impersonal frame does not take a nominative.

The state family marks the past with the frozen neuter было, which never agrees with the dative person Маше. Была (feminine) would need a personal nominative subject (Маша была дома), a different construction.

patternRecognition.explanation: Нельзя is the prohibition predicative + infinitive: the permission family.
Нужно plus an infinitive reports that the action is required: the necessity family.
Следует is the formal 'ought to' predicative: the advice family recommends without demanding.
Пора announces the moment has arrived, and the motion verb is dropped before the destination домой: the timing family.
Холодно is the short state predicative with a dative person (мне): the state family reporting a personal feeling.
Кажется reports an opinion that arises 'by itself' for the dative person (мне): the reflexive family on -ся.

reviewVocab.definition: an impersonal construction (a sentence with no nominative subject; the person who feels or needs, if named, appears in the dative or in 'у + gen')
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Маше было грустно' нет именительного подлежащего: это безличная конструкция.

reviewVocab.definition: the category of state (short predicatives that name feelings, ambient states, or evaluations in an impersonal construction: холодно, грустно, трудно)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Маше было трудно' слово 'трудно' принадлежит к категории состояния.

reviewVocab.definition: the было / будет tense word: in an impersonal construction it stays in the fixed neuter form (было for the past, будет for the future) and never changes for the gender of the dative person
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Маше было грустно' слово 'было' несёт прошедшее время и остаётся в среднем роде.

reviewVocab.definition: the absence frame: нет plus the genitive of the missing thing or absent person; tense rides on нет / не было / не будет
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'У меня нет времени' слово 'нет' требует родительного падежа: времени.
